text:
alex_sales: Kicking off POC scoping with AcmeRetail — they want a 2-week pilot. Goals: search precision for product FAQs (top-1 accuracy), customer intent reranking, and a toolcall to place test orders. Need pricing bands and security Qs answered.

mira_se: Thanks. Quick Qs: expected corpus size? avg / max doc length? Will embeddings be used for recall + rerank?

olivia_cust: Corpus ~120k docs, avg ~300 tokens, max ~5k tokens (some long spec PDFs). We'll do embeddings for recall, then rerank to improve top results.

mira_se: Good. For rerank I suggest vector candidates -> lightweight decoder reranker (8k) or cross-encoder. Toolcalling: function-calling support required for order placement (low-latency REST).

alex_sales: They mentioned transcripts and long chat history. Do we need 32k context? What's the pricing hit?

mira_se: If they want full-conversation QA/summarization across entire transcripts, 32k helps. For retrieval + rerank + toolcalls, 8k usually sufficient. Pricing: hosted per-token; Dedicated reduces marginal cost and gives predictable throughput — we'll show both options.

raj_security: Security checklist: customer requires SOC2, VPC/private deployment for PII, KMS/HSM for keys, and audit logs. Can we run a POC under Private or Dedicated with those guarantees?

mira_se: Yes. Short POC options: Dedicated in their region with VPC peering (faster to stand up) or Private if they insist on full customer-managed control. We'll need completed security questionnaire & NDA.

alex_sales: Proposed timeline: week0 NDA + sample dataset share, week1 infra + model config, week2 run evals and demo. Need to lock acceptance criteria.

olivia_cust: KPIs: top-1 precision >= 85% on a 500-prompt eval set; rerank improves MRR by at least +15%; avg end-to-end latency < 450ms for one-shot search+rerank. Toolcall success rate >= 98%.

mira_se: We'll produce an eval harness: 500 labeled prompts, embedding recall @100, MRR calc. We'll test model variants: quantized 8k model, 32k model for transcripts, and a mid-sized reranker. Also validate tokenization + cost with sample runs.

alex_sales: Customer asks about spend cap for the pilot. They want a hard cap. Can we do that?

mira_se: Yes — hosted: usage caps + alerts. Dedicated: offer 1-month trial credits or a capped commit. I'll coordinate with finance for a pilot offer.

raj_security: Please include data retention policy for POC (they want 30 days), and confirm logs/audit export.

olivia_cust: 30 days retention is acceptable.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: new checklist created: "acmeretail-poc-checklist" by mira_se.

mira_se: Action items: (1) alex — draft proposal with spend cap & Dedicated vs Hosted pricing, (2) raj — send SOC2 + KMS + retention templates, (3) olivia — share 500 eval prompts and a 2k-sample of long docs, (4) mira — stand up eval harness and initial model configs (8k quantized + 32k trial).

alex_sales: Got it. I'll draft proposal and loop in finance. Ping here if anything blocks. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
